newsitem.title: USA: INTERPUBLIC BUYS MAJORITY IN ADDIS-WECHSLER.
newsitem.headline: INTERPUBLIC BUYS MAJORITY IN ADDIS-WECHSLER.

text.p: Interpublic Group of Cos Inc on Wednesday said it bought a majority interest in Addis-Wechsler and Associates, a Hollywood personal management and production company.

Under the agreement, Addis-Wechsler will continue to expand its core business while also serving to extend Interpublic's reach into entertainment communications and content. Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.
Interpublic is a holding company whose units include the McCann-Erickson, Lintas and Lowe Group advertising agencies.

Founded as a Los Angeles-based talent management and production company in 1989 by Keith Addis and Nick Wechsler, Addis-Wechsler represents film and television talent, writers and directors, including Jack Lemmon, Billy Bob Thornton, Richard Dreyfuss, Leonardo DiCaprio and many others.
